t: You're at Euston Station, the southern terminus of the West Coast Main Line and Britain's busiest inter-city passenger terminal. It is the gateway from London to the West Midlands, the North West, North Wales and Scotland. The architect Richard Seifert, who also designed the NatWest Tower and Centre Point, is credited with designing it. Matthew Flinders is buried here too. He was the navigator who led the first inshore circumnavigation of mainland Australia, and who popularised the name Australia for the whole continent.
